prompt: A survey drone banking over a dense city rooftop landscape at night, seen from slightly above and behind, its sensor pod glowing. Cinematic, dense fine texture, haze and dust in the air, deep shadows, black background.
The same drone, one small step further along the SAME banking turn: nose swung slightly further round, wings tilted a little more. Nothing else changes.
The same drone, one small step further again along the same turn. Nothing else changes.

A laser scan line sweeping across the ornate stone facade of a historic university building at night, the scanned strip resolving into millions of glowing measured points while the rest stays in shadow. Cinematic, dense texture, black background.
The same facade, the sweep advanced a little further across it: slightly more of the stonework has turned into glowing points. Small incremental change only.
The same facade, the sweep advanced a little further again. Small incremental change only.

An aerial view of a city block at night where the surfaces are being classified: roofs, facades, roads and trees separating into distinct tones as understanding spreads across the scene. Cinematic, dense texture, black background.
The same view, the classification spread a little further across the block. Small incremental change only.
The same view, the classification spread further again, most of the block now separated into classes. Small incremental change only.

A construction crane standing over a half-built structure at night, jib extended to one side, the site below dense with scaffolding and material. Cinematic, dense texture, dust in the air, black background.
The same crane, its jib swung a small step further round; the structure below has gained a little more built volume. Nothing else changes.
The same crane, jib swung a small step further again, structure a little taller. Nothing else changes.
